# awscontrib_connect_data_table (Data Source)

Looks up one Amazon Connect data table by ID or exact name within an instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "connect_instance_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Amazon Connect instance identifier."
}

variable "data_table_name" {
  type        = string
  description = "Exact data-table name to look up."
}

data "awscontrib_connect_data_table" "by_name" {
  instance_id = var.connect_instance_id
  name        = var.data_table_name
}

data "awscontrib_connect_data_table" "by_id" {
  instance_id   = var.connect_instance_id
  data_table_id = data.awscontrib_connect_data_table.by_name.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Amazon Connect instance identifier.

### Optional

- `data_table_id` (String) Data-table identifier. Specify exactly one of data_table_id or name.
- `name` (String) Exact data-table name. Specify exactly one of data_table_id or name; the remote name is returned for ID lookups.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Data-table ARN.
- `description` (String) Data-table description, when set.
- `id` (String) Data-table identifier.
- `status` (String) Data-table status.
- `tags` (Map of String) Data-table tags returned by Amazon Connect.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time-zone identifier used by the data table.
- `value_lock_level` (String) Value concurrency lock level.
